name: meeting follow-up drafter
description: generates follow-up emails from your action items and key decisions.

name: linear issue creator
description: turns action items into structured linear issues with descriptions and acceptance criteria.

name: decision log
description: extracts decisions across meetings into a running log with context and date.

name: meeting prep
description: reviews past meetings with a contact to prepare you for the next one.

name: weekly summary
description: aggregates a week of meetings into a single digest with themes and open items.

name: stakeholder update
description: generates a polished status update for leadership or investors from recent meetings.

name: accountability tracker
description: tracks who committed to what across meetings and flags overdue items.

name: topic tracker
description: traces how a specific topic evolved across meetings over time.

name: meeting debrief
description: structured post-mortem with conversation dynamics, signals, and suggested follow-ups.

name: meeting roi analyzer
description: scores your meetings by outcomes produced and identifies time sinks.
